full_judgment:
Md. Joynul Abedin J: This petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 9.11.2004 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.939 of 1995 discharging the rule refusing to quash the proceedings in Special Tribunal Case No.382 of 1993 arising out of G.R. Case No.82 of 1992 and Lohagara Police Station Case No.12 dated 23.8.1992. 

 3. The police investigated the case and submitted charge-sheet against the petitioner anti others under section 156(8) of the Customs Act read with section 2513 of the Special Powers Act, 1974. 

 4. The case came up for trial before the Special Tribunal (Additional Sessions Judge, 2nd Court), Chittagong and was numbered as Special Tribunal Case No.382 of 1993 and the charge was framed against the petitioner and others under section 2513 of the Special Powers Act. The petitioner then filed an application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing the proceedings in the aforesaid criminal case on the ground that the allegations do not disclose any offence against the petitioner under section 25B of the Special Powers Act and the same were an abuse of the process of the Court. Hence the present criminal petition for leave appeal. 

 5. Mr. Maqbul Ahmed, the learned Advocate for the petitioner submits that if the prosecution case as made out in the first information report and in the charge sheet is admitted as a whole and believed to be true it does not disclose any prima facie case as against the accused petitioner inasmuch as the allegations do not attract the mischief of section 25(B) of the Special Powers Act, 1974 and thus the charge framed against the accused petitioner is not maintainable in law.
